summary:
Convert a timestamp, as returned by time(), into an array representing local time. The array has the following form:

   ({秒, 分, 时, 日, 月, 年, 星期, 天, 时差, 时区, 夏令时})

The following historical <localtime.h> excerpt defines the array indices. Its comment about a minimum year of 1900 is not a runtime lower-bound guarantee: the current implementation calculates the calendar year as tm_year + 1900, subject to the host system's time range.

#ifndef _LOCALTIME_H
#define _LOCALTIME_H

#define LT_SEC 0        // Seconds after the minute (0..59)
#define LT_MIN 1        // Minutes after the hour (0..59)
#define LT_HOUR 2       // Hour since midnight (0..23)
#define LT_MDAY 3       // Day of the month (1..31)
#define LT_MON 4        // Months since January (0..11)
#define LT_YEAR 5       // Year (guarenteed to be >= 1900)
#define LT_WDAY 6       // Days since Sunday (0..6)
#define LT_YDAY 7       // Days since January 1 (0..365)
#define LT_GMTOFF 8     // Seconds after GMT (UTC)
#define LT_ZONE 9       // Timezone name
#define LT_ISDST 10     // Is Daylight Saving Time?(0 || 1)

#endif

The field types and meanings are:
   int LT_SEC      Seconds (0..59)
   int LT_MIN      Minutes (0..59)
   int LT_HOUR     Hours (0..23)
   int LT_MDAY     Day of the month (1..31)
   int LT_MON      Month (0..11)
   int LT_YEAR     Calendar year
   int LT_WDAY     Day of the week (0..6)
   int LT_YDAY     Day of the year (0..365)
   int LT_GMTOFF   Difference from Greenwich time in seconds (UTC)
   string LT_ZONE  Local time zone name
   int LT_ISDST    Whether daylight saving time applies
details:
Notes
Under mudos, localtime is limited to January 19, 2038 at 11:14:07, with a maximum timestamp of 2147483647 (2**31-1). Beyond this limit, it starts again at January 1, 1970 at 00:00:00, or 08:00:00 Beijing time.

Under fluffos v2017, the limit is December 31, 2147483647 at 23:59:59, with a maximum timestamp of 67767976233503999. Values above the limit return 0.

Under fluffos v2019, the limit depends on the operating system. On windows, the limit is January 1, 3001 at 15:59:59, with a maximum timestamp of 32535244799; values above it return 0. On ubuntu, the limit is December 31, 2147483647 at 23:59:59, with a maximum timestamp of 67767976233503999. Beyond that, it overflows and starts at January 1, -2147483648 at 00:00:00. Values above 67768036191647999 return 0.
